mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gb28181_channel (platform_id, device_id, channel_id, channel_name, catalog_online, zlm_server_id, vhost, app, stream, play_url, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{platformId}, #{deviceId}, #{channelId}, #{name}, #{catalogOnline}, #{zlmServerId}, #{vhost}, #{app}, #{stream}, #{playUrl}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel_name = VALUES(channel_name), catalog_online = VALUES(catalog_online), zlm_server_id = VALUES(zlm_server_id), vhost = VALUES(vhost), app = VALUES(app), stream = VALUES(stream), play_url = VALUES(play_url), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform_id, device_id, channel_id, channel_name, catalog_online, zlm_server_id, vhost, app, stream, play_url FROM gb28181_channel WHERE zlm_server_id = #{zlmServerId} AND vhost IS NOT NULL AND app IS NOT NULL AND stream IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE gb28181_channel SET media_online = #{available}, last_media_seen_at = CASE WHEN #{available} THEN NOW() ELSE last_media_seen_at END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
